QUOTE: "The library itself spawns no threads. The index's thread layer lists four spawn sites, all in `programs/`." and "Locks are taken through global function pointers (`mbedtls_mutex_lock` at `library/threading.c:103`... The backend is therefore swappable through `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the library spawns no threads (all spawn sites are in programs/) and that library/threading.c supplies the mutex abstraction (lock function pointers, pthread backend, ALT hook) used by threaded callers.
